summary_en: ¥2.00 per share dividend approved for FY2026.06 (ended June 2026), effective 28 September 2026, aggregate ¥54.9M from retained earnings. Restoration follows achievement of black-ink results (operating, ordinary, and net profit all positive) and completion of business turnaround final phase.
title_en: Notice of Year-End Dividend (Dividend Restoration) for Fiscal Year Ending June 2026
translation_en_brief: Precision System Science announced on 14 August 2026 that its board has approved submission of a year-end dividend proposal to the 41st ordinary shareholders' meeting (scheduled for 25 September 2026). The dividend is set at ¥2.00 per share, totalling ¥54.9 million, to be sourced from retained earnings with an effective date of 28 September 2026 and a record date of 30 June 2026. The company stated that this dividend restoration decision was made after the company achieved profitability across all metrics—operating profit, ordinary profit, and net profit—in FY2026.06 (ended June 2026), and as the business turnaround programme has reached its final phase. The decision also reflects a balanced approach to dividend payout and retained earnings retention.
